description: This file defines an abstract class `BatchWorker` that implements an asynchronous, scheduled worker pattern for processing queued work in cycles. It manages task scheduling, synchronization, and notifications for starting, running, and awaiting batch work, with a concrete implementation `BatchWorkerFromDelegate` that accepts a delegate as the work to perform.

classes.name: BatchWorker
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a scheduled asynchronous batch worker that handles queued work cycles, ensuring only one cycle runs at a time and supports notifications and waiting for work to be processed.

classes.name: BatchWorkerFromDelegate
classes.description: A concrete subclass of BatchWorker that executes a provided delegate as its work cycle.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Abstract method to define the work executed in each cycle.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals to the worker that there is more work to process.

methods.name: Notify(DateTime utcTime)
methods.description: Schedules a notification at a specific UTC time to trigger work.

methods.name: ScheduleNotify
methods.description: Private method to delay execution until the scheduled notification time.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Private method to initiate a new work cycle.

methods.name: CheckForMoreWork
methods.description: Handles the completion of a work cycle and determines if subsequent cycles are needed.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks whether the worker is currently idle.

methods.name: WaitForCurrentWorkToBeServiced
methods.description: Returns a task that completes when current and possibly the next work cycles are finished.

methods.name: CreateNextWorkCyclePromise
methods.description: Creates a promise (TaskCompletionSource) that signals when the next work cycle starts.

methods.name: NotifyAndWaitForWorkToBeServiced
methods.description: Signals new work and waits for current and next work cycles to complete.

methods.name: Work
methods.description: Override in subclasses to specify the work performed per cycle.

methods.name: BatchWorkerFromDelegate
methods.description: Subclass of BatchWorker that executes a delegate function as its work cycle.
